facts.fact: INTIC's post says Decree No. 67/2017 of 1 December approves the Regulation of the E-Government Interoperability Framework.
facts.system: Decreto n.o 67/2017 - Regulamento do Quadro de Interoperabilidade de Governo Electronico

facts.fact: INTIC presented on 23 October 2026 in Maputo a proposal to revise Decree 67/2017, raising the guiding principles from 10 to 15; the revision is proposed, not adopted.
